clock_policy: conditional final-export research; original application arrival unreconstructed; explicit hypothetical delay/revision cases only; no production or market-wide profit claim
existing_strategy: orb-long-research-v2 with unchanged feature_snapshot and risk/simulation policies; no simplification to avoid required history
performance_requires: ADMITTED evidence certificate followed by separately frozen full experiment before results
permitted_new_data: Bounded public issuer/reference/specification evidence and at most one existing-authorized corporate-action query for required lookback, no paid acquisition
reduction_rule: Include a symbol-session only if every required predicate is certified before any strategy run. No switching names, no no-trade exemption. Unknown status intervals excluded; unresolved open exposure cannot receive invented exits or be silently dropped.
selection: All original symbols and sessions; reduce only on preregistered identity/action/status/execution/feature evidence, never outcomes
